derivation: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the plural of H8565 (תַּן); fountain of jackals;

occurrences.text: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, even before the dragon well, and to the dung port, and viewed the walls of Jerusalem, which were broken down, and the gates thereof were consumed with fire.
